classification.difficultyReason: Read sign regions from three supplied parabolas, include or exclude zeroes appropriately, and confirm each result with test values.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use the given graph to help solve each inequation.

spec.description: Upward parabola through the origin and 4; no grid or additional numeric labels. Both branches continue with arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is always visible; solution interval is hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph is below the $x$-axis between its zeroes, $0$ and $4$. The strict inequality excludes both endpoints.

Hence $0<x<4$.

spec.description: Upward parabola, intercept labels -1 and 3 on x-axis and -3 on y-axis, with arrowed axes and branches; no grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is always visible; solution intervals are hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph is on or above the $x$-axis outside the zeroes, $-1$ and $3$. Equality includes both intercepts.

Hence $x\le-1$ or $x\ge3$.

spec.description: Downward parabola through the origin and 2, with the positive intercept labelled, arrowed axes and continuing branches; no grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is always visible; solution intervals are hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph is on or below the $x$-axis outside the zeroes, $0$ and $2$. Equality includes both intercepts.

Hence $x\le0$ or $x\ge2$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Confirm your answers to part a by using tables of values.

inlines.text: The zeroes are 0 and 4. The test values give signs +, −, + across the three intervals, so
